triage.selection_bias: the 24 scans with the most FN+FP across both lanes; not a random sample
triage.verdict_quality: one triage agent per scan, cross-sections from raw points; no second blind verifier

mechanisms.BEND_MISS: a real formed bend gets no line in the lane at all (mostly short: tabs, lips, feet, return flanges; see recall_by_gold_length)
mechanisms.OVER_EXTENSION: line on the right fold but stretched along a free edge or past the part (fails the 60% span rule; usually 1 FN + 1 FP)
mechanisms.COLLINEAR_MERGE: one line across two collinear bends separated by a gap, relief, window or slot
mechanisms.SEAM_OR_EDGE_FALSE_LINE: line on a box-corner butt/open seam, a cut free edge or flat plate (no bend)
mechanisms.CAD_TARGET_EXTRACTION_WRONG: the lane's own CAD bend list is wrong (phantom rolled/corner bends, collapsed collinear bends, missing targets)
mechanisms.DETECTION_DISCARDED_NO_CAD_SLOT: the runtime measured/detected a real bend but emitted nothing (unmatched detection or placeholder-only geometry)
mechanisms.REGISTRATION_FAILURE: runtime worker refused/crashed on alignment, or the shared alignment slid so nothing matched
mechanisms.SELECTION_DROPPED_GOOD_CANDIDATE: a correct candidate existed (decomposition/pool/CAD-gated) but the typed union or fusion dropped it
mechanisms.LABEL_ERROR: gold line(s) not on a physical bend or real bends missing from gold
